ranking_definition.name: exact iterative marginal expected-DTI gain under the pinned physical corroboration field w
ranking_definition.why: R0 = dot_thin(H19-5, 2.8) & (d_cat > 2 px) is a pure geometric Poisson-disk thinning; the parent stores NO per-dot score, so the ranking must be rebuilt. Brief §5 says rebuild it from the recorded recipe; the recorded recipe of every later lineage step (GEMSDOE32 PRUNE, R1 = PRUNEp3px) ranks by exact iterative marginal expected-DTI contribution under the same canary-clean, label-free physical field w. That is adopted here as 'the parent's own ranking'.
ranking_definition.field_w: build_physical_field_and_canaries (19 official bands + parent detector ridges + GDR 1391 geothermometry), all channels leakage-canaried at symmetric AUC <= 0.90

fixed_dose.source: Brief §5 MASS: 'drop the lowest-ranked 10% / add the next-ranked 10%'

r10minus.operation: drop the 3,765 lowest exact-marginal-DTI dots from the full 37,654-dot parent set
r10minus.reason: A removed dot lowers S by 1 for certain and lowers T only by the credit it uniquely carried. Under DTI = T / (0.2T + 0.2(S-M) + 0.8|G|) the denominator falls even when T is unchanged, so the ranking targets exactly the dots with the smallest T-loss per unit of S. The gain is capped because w is only a ~0.68-AUC proxy for truth: roughly a third of 'low-prior' dots may sit on real unmapped faults.

r10plus.operation: add the 3,765 next-ranked un-emitted dots (H19-5 support, d_cat > 3 px, never parent-emitted)
r10plus.reason: Every un-emitted H19-5 pixel was skipped by the 2.8 px dot-thinning, so the surviving candidates sit mostly 100-280 m from an already-emitted dot, i.e. inside the 300 m triangular kernel that already credits that strand. Saturation: T barely moves while S rises by 3,765. This is the falsifiable core of the 'mass is not the lever' reading of GEMSDOE76-81.

r10swap.operation: count-matched substitution: drop the 3,765 lowest-ranked parent dots and add the 3,765 next-ranked un-emitted dots (d_cat > 3 px); count held at 37,654
r10swap.reason: The only arm that isolates ranking quality from mass: S is fixed at 37,654 so any change must come from moving mass from low-credit to higher-credit cells. Predicted to be the best of the three but still bounded by the same ~0.68-AUC ceiling on w and by the saturation of the un-emitted pool.
